thread:
maria: Quick design review 1: Playground streaming micro UX: stop/regenerate/continue, token indicator, promptbook sidesheet. 20m?
kevin: SG. Two infra notes: token events can be emitted from runtime but we should throttle them (150ms suggested) to avoid UI churn. Also resume requires keeping KV for a TTL.
jasmin: UX thought: tiny pulsing dot + live count inline with message tail on desktop. On stop it morphs to a small badge showing "Saved 00:30" + Continue/Regenerate actions.
agnes: Accessibility: Stop must be role=button; announcements via aria-live polite: "Generation paused. Saved for 30 seconds. Press Continue to resume or Regenerate to restart." Keyboard shortcuts: Esc=Stop, Ctrl/Cmd+R=Regenerate.
samir: Backend: propose default TTL 30s (configurable 60s). Continue = reuse KV; Regenerate = purge KV. I'll validate perf impact on batching.
olivia: Copy bundle: "Stop stream", "Continue stream", "Regenerate reply", tooltip hints include shortcuts. I will collect strings.
kevin: Mobile: collapse indicator under 360px to a single tappable dot that expands to controls. Reduced-motion respect required.
jasmin: I'll mock: inline-pill, right-pinned-pill, and mobile-collapsed variants. Posting in #design-assets.
agnes: Also ensure color is not the only signal (text + icon), contrast AA, and touch targets >=44px. Provide SR text snippets.
maria: Action list: Jasmin 1 mocks, Agnes 1 aria + keyboard map, Samir validate TTL perf, Kevin add throttling + mobile behavior, Olivia finalize copy. Reconvene after mocks.
